name: Bitbucket pull requests
description: Review the diff of Bitbucket Cloud PRs the agent links in a session, then merge them after live checks and your confirmation, without opening Bitbucket.

settings.label: Atlassian account email
settings.description: For an Atlassian API token. Leave empty for a repository access token.

settings.label: API token
settings.description: Needs read:repository:bitbucket, read:pullrequest:bitbucket and write:pullrequest:bitbucket. Repository write permission may also be required to merge.

link.label: Create an Atlassian API token (choose “Create API token with scopes” → Bitbucket)

settings.label: Approvals needed from others in Bitbucket
settings.description: Your review in Muster is the sign-off; this is extra. Author approvals do not count. Bitbucket's own merge checks always apply.

tools.name: bitbucket_pr_context
tools.description: Read a Bitbucket PR's diff, source and target commits, approvals, build statuses, unresolved tasks, conflicts and mergeability checks. Read-only; cannot approve, comment or merge. Give the full PR URL.

actions.title: Merge reviewed PR
actions.description: Use the Pull requests tab in the session's Files panel: read the diff, mark it reviewed, then merge.
